list.title: Payments
list.description: Invoices, captures, refunds and failed charges

description.payment: Send {{name}} this link to pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Link.
description.combined: Send {{name}} this link to pay, then authorise the security deposit hold on the same card.
description.deposit: Send {{name}} this link to authorise the security deposit hold. Nothing is charged unless you capture it after the return.

link.label: Link
link.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it instead.

message.payment: Hi {{name}}, please pay {{amount}} for your rental {{reference}} here: {{url}}
message.combined: Hi {{name}}, please pay {{amount}} for your rental {{reference}} and authorise the {{deposit}} security deposit here: {{url}}
message.deposit: Hi {{name}}, please authorise the {{deposit}} security deposit for your rental {{reference}} here: {{url}}

link.depositLater: The {{deposit}} security deposit is asked for separately, from the day before pickup.

manual.title: Record a payment
manual.description: For money taken outside Stripe, such as cash. Nothing is charged.
manual.hint: Enter what the renter paid, up to the {{max}} still owed. A part payment leaves the rest due.

capture.title: Capture the deposit
capture.description: Take part or all of the {{held}} on hold. Whatever isn't taken goes back to the renter.
capture.hint: Take up to the {{max}} held. Whatever you don't capture goes back to the renter straight away.

refund.title: Refund a payment
refund.description: Card payments go back to the card. Cash is returned by hand and only recorded here.
refund.hint: Refund up to the {{max}} left on this payment. A card refund takes 5 to 10 days to reach the renter.

reasons.payments_not_ready: Connect Stripe in Settings → Payments to send payment links.
reasons.deposit_already_held: The deposit is already on hold.
reasons.not_returned: Capture or release the deposit once the vehicle is back.
reasons.not_before_pickup: The vehicle has already been picked up.
reasons.not_fully_paid: Pickup needs the rental paid and the deposit on hold.
reasons.not_on_rental: The vehicle isn't out on this booking.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.description: Send {{name}} a link to the receipt for booking {{reference}}. They can view it and download the PDF.
receipt.subject: Your receipt from {{company}} for {{reference}}
receipt.message: Hi {{name}}, here is your receipt for rental {{reference}}: {{url}}

pay.title: Pay for your rental

paid.title: Payment received
paid.body: {{company}} has your payment of {{amount}} for booking {{reference}}. You can close this page.
paid.bodyDepositLater: {{company}} has your payment of {{amount}} for booking {{reference}}. They will send a separate link for the {{deposit}} security deposit before pickup.

processing.title: Payment processing
processing.body: Your bank is still confirming the payment. This page updates on its own.

closed.title: This link is no longer active
closed.body: Ask {{company}} for a new payment link.

invalid.title: This payment link isn't valid
invalid.body: It may have been replaced by a newer one. Ask the rental company for a new link.

pay.unavailable: Card payments aren't available right now. Please contact the rental company.
pay.consentWithDeposit: By paying, you also authorise {{company}} to hold {{deposit}} on this card as your security deposit. Nothing is taken unless your rental agreement calls for it, and the hold is released after the return.
pay.consentDeposit: {{company}} holds {{deposit}} on this card as your security deposit. Nothing is taken unless your rental agreement calls for it, and the hold is released after the return.

held.title: Deposit on hold
held.body: {{company}} holds {{deposit}} on your card for booking {{reference}}. You can close this page.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: {{company}} has your payment of {{amount}} and holds {{deposit}} as your deposit for booking {{reference}}. You can close this page.

pay.depositFailed: The deposit hold didn't go through.
pay.greeting: Hi {{name}}, check the details below before you pay.
pay.depositGreeting: Hi {{name}}, check the details below before you authorise the hold.
pay.depositNotCharged: Held on your card, not charged
pay.secure: Secure payment by Stripe. Card details go straight to Stripe.

unreachable.title: We couldn't load your payment
unreachable.body: This is usually brief. Your link is fine, so please try again in a moment.

invalid.title: This receipt link isn't valid
invalid.body: Ask the rental company for a new link.
